summary: NFC table stands and counter displays put a tap-to-act NFC tag at the point of customer interaction — on restaurant tables, hotel reception desks, retail counters and waiting areas. Customers tap to view the menu, leave a Google review, connect to Wi-Fi, follow on social media or request service.
